typing_requirements.allowed_category: A declared native-B-linear comparison, with an explicit adjunction/mate when the target is RHom_B(B_sigma,Y_sigma).
typing_requirements.forbidden_reinterpretation: No operation-preserving forward map into literal ambient RHom_A is inferred.
typing_requirements.ring_and_support: Preserve all spectator coefficients and each original localization domain. Conductor evaluation cannot be extended to an inverted short occurrence.
typing_requirements.source: Do not replace the complete framed source by C, its free resolution, or rank-one cohomology.
typing_requirements.degree: The compiler uses the incoming differential to the degree receiving the shifted coefficient line. This is degree 3 in the target convention; the physical source degree is not assigned before its frame table is supplied.
typing_requirements.operation_variance: Native precomposition and contravariant postcomposition remain distinct until an explicit mate is given.
